claims: Artemis 2 mission will launch from Launch Complex 39B at NASA’s Kennedy Space Center in Florida.
Crewed Orion spacecraft will lift off atop the Space Launch System (SLS) rocket from Launch Complex 39B at NASA’s Kennedy Space Center.
Launch Complex 39B at NASA’s Kennedy Space Center is used for Exploration Ground Systems.
Kennedy Space Center is located in Merritt Island, Florida.
Launch pad for Artemis 2 is Launch Complex 39B (LC-39B).
Artemis 2 mission type is 10-day crewed lunar flyby.
Artemis 2 launch is aimed at testing deep space capabilities.
Artemis 2 launch has viewing opportunities for the public along Florida's Space Coast.
